title: Finite etale extension over a stalk before neighbourhood spreading
statement: Let $S$ be an integral normal Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, $c:C\to S$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, and $\sigma:S\to C$ a section [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Put $K=k(\eta)$ for the function field. Let $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ and $j:C_\eta\to C$ exhibit the cartesian generic fibre, and let $s_\eta:\operatorname{Spec}K\to C_\eta$ satisfy $q s_\eta=1$ and $j s_\eta=\sigma a_\eta$, where $a_\eta:\operatorname{Spec}K\to S$ is canonical [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $G$ be a finite group with invertible order on $S$, and $Z\to C_\eta$ a finite etale $G$-torsor with a $K$-rational point above $s_\eta$. Let $U\subsetneq S$ be open with $\eta\in U$, $C_U=c^{-1}(U)$, $i_U:C_U\to C$ its inclusion, and $j_U:C_\eta\to C_U$ with $i_U j_U=j$. Let $P\to C_U$ be finite etale, and $\psi:Z\to P$ exhibit its cartesian generic restriction. Then there exist $s\notin U$ and a finite etale cover $Q\to C_s^{\mathrm{loc}}$, where $a_s:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to S$ is canonical and $C_s^{\mathrm{loc}}=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$, with an isomorphism $\operatorname{pr}_1^*P\simeq\operatorname{pr}_2^*Q$ over $C_U\times_C C_s^{\mathrm{loc}}$. This conclusion constructs a model only over the stalk, and asserts no neighbourhood model.

proof.text: Choose a generic point s of an irreducible component of the nonempty closed complement of U. In the closed subspace, if t specializes to s, closure(s) is contained in closure(t). Maximal irreducibility forces equality; T0 uniqueness of a generic point forces t=s. This is the proved private exists_minimal_boundary lemma.

Form the actual relative normalization N of the composite f:P -> C and pull it back to L=C times_S Spec O(S,s). Apply the finiteness lemma and then the conditional etaleness lemma. Their property proofs package this concrete pullback morphism into the finite etale object Q. No arbitrary cover is selected from an unproved existence theorem.

The identity on P and its structure map form a pullback square over the open inclusion i_U, since i_U is monic. The resulting finite pullback has trivial normalization. Normalization commutes with smooth base change, so its canonical comparison over i_U is an isomorphism and gives a cartesian square from P to N. Paste it with the two pullback squares over the overlap. The cospans agree by the overlap condition, so isoIsPullback gives an isomorphism over the overlap. Lift it by MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk and ObjectProperty.isoMk to the two finite etale pullback objects. This step is fully proved in Lean from Mathlib normalization and pullback lemmas.

proof_origin.note: Compiling reduction into finiteness and conditional etaleness of an explicitly constructed relative normalization; boundary choice and comparison are fully proved.

A finite etale cover over a smooth family extends from a punctured local normal base if its generic torsor is split on a section
